cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.summary: legacy apkgs with subdeck root fail to import
cases.description:
To repro:

- create a card and put it in a foo::bar deck, then export that deck using the legacy exporter
- attempt to import it using the new importer, and be told you should run "check database" :-)

Because this is not such an uncommon case, we should ideally handle this instead of throwing an error. Maybe a low-effort solution would be, when this error is encountered, to run the part of the DB check that adds missing parents. I think you mentioned something like this in the past Rumo.

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix some apkg import issues

Closes #1835. That was an unintended side effect of using the gather code for both im- and export.
One more issue I realised: Unexported siblings don't get generated on import. I'll deal with that after plaintext imports, because it won't be easy to add this, but it needs to be taken care of when importing text at the very least.
